vision.name: Black Punishment
vision.text:
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Raise your anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
HIT: Until the start of your next turn, whenever a card banishes itself after use your opponent destroys the top card of his Life Deck.
(Most Recent Printing)
vision.note: prints '(Most Recent Printing)' at the end of the text box (MRP reprint). Updated text vs S01 C19 ('whenever a card is banished')
